name: red-far-volley-park
title: DRAFT Auto: Red Far Delay + Volley + Park (unmeasured)
description: DRAFT, requested 2026-11-21 for BLUE AUDIENCE (BlueAudienceVolleyParkAutonomous runs this file point-mirrored). Red frame: left side on the far wall, facing +X (toward the centre line), front at the centre line. Wait 10 s, volley the 4 preload at the far cell, then back up to park with only the rear-right corner (about 3 x 3 in) inside the red loading zone. Solo, this alliance's far cell (blue: audience cell) is lowered at the start; it is raised only if a partner tips the hive during the 10 s delay. Blue mirror: audience wall on the left, facing red, volley at the blue audience cell, park with one corner in the blue loading zone.

pose.provenance: DERIVED from the measured 396 x 374 mm chassis (15.591 x 14.724 in, robot.json). Facing +X, left side on the far wall (y = 72 - 14.724 / 2 = 64.638) and the FRONT exactly on the centre line (x = -15.591 / 2 = -7.796, the front edge at -0.0007 in, not over it); the team confirmed this is how the robot is placed. robot.json's expanded length was set to the chassis length on 2026-11-21 so this validates; the depollinator is stowed here and never deployed. Blue mirror (7.796, -64.638, 180 deg). Assumes the Pinpoint tracking point is the chassis centre (robot.json caveat).

steps.name: aim
steps.notes: Latch the target and spin up during the delay. AUTHORED: red aims the far cell, the blue wrapper aims the blue audience cell. About 50.0 in to the cell opening, inside the measured shot table.
Requested 10 s delay before the volley (gives a partner time to tip the hive so this cell is up).

steps.name: volley
steps.notes: The TeleOp full volley (RT + LT). Timed, not counted: 2.5 s of feed empties the 4 preload. FIRE: if not ready within 3 s it feeds anyway (turret homed only). after OFF: flywheel stops. No ledger expect on purpose (same as red-far): Zenith's solo hive model has this cell lowered, so an expect raises LEGAL_APPROACH and blocks deploy.

Pull straight off the wall first (first control point at the start x) (clears flower1's foot behind, x -27 to -21), then back toward the red wall holding heading. End pose (-56.2, 52.36, 0 deg): the rear-right corner sits at (-64.0, 45.0), 3 in inside the loading zone's corner (x < -61, y < 48); the other three corners are outside it. Blue mirror (56.2, -52.36, 180 deg), corner at (64.0, -45.0).
